description: Read data through an authorized API-key/PAT connection using a GET request. Aurocrypt controls authentication and destination hosts and injects the stored credential server-side; credentials are never returned. Use vault_invoke_write for any operation that sends data or changes provider state.

connection_id.description: Identifier of the authorized API-key/PAT connection to use, from vault_connections.

credential.description: For owner-bound custom APIs only. Aurocrypt chooses Bearer by default; set this only when the provider docs require a custom header or query parameter. The stored key is still injected server-side and never returned.

mode.description: How the stored credential is presented: a bearer Authorization header, a custom header, or a query parameter.

name.description: Header or query parameter name, required when mode is header or query.

scheme.description: Authentication scheme prefix for the credential value, when the provider requires one.

headers.description: Extra request headers as name/value pairs. Authentication is controlled by Aurocrypt and cannot be set here.

operation.description: Operation name recorded for this request. Defaults to api.request.

path.description: Provider-relative request path, appended to the connection's controlled destination.

name: vault_invoke_read
title: Read through an authorized API-key connection
